title: AI-driven discovery of synergistic drug combinations against pancreatic cancer.
summary: Of 88 tested combinations, 51 showed synergy in PANC-1 cells; the larger total of 307 is not 307 new prospective ML hits. No clinical efficacy established.
organization: National Institutes of Health; National Center for Advancing Translational Sciences; MIT Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence Laboratory

evidence.tested: Of 88 tested combinations, 51 showed synergy in PANC-1 cells; the larger total of 307 is not 307 new prospective ML hits. No clinical efficacy established.
evidence.unknown: The date refers to the cited version. Earlier public versions and independent replication were not systematically verified.
evidence.ai_role: Graph convolutional networks; random forest is the AI method documented in the editorial source review.
